company.title: Let's set up your workspace
company.description: Start with the basics about your company. It takes a couple of minutes and everything can be changed later.

hints.locale: Used across the interface and in emails.
hints.timezone: Used in dates, reminders and reports.
hints.currency: Used for deal amounts and revenue reports.

business.title: Tell us about your business
business.description: Your answers choose the features and the initial setup that suit you. We only ask once.
business.typeLegend: What kind of business do you run?
business.teamLegend: How many people will use Aphel?
business.required: Choose the kind of business to continue.

freelancer.label: Freelancer
freelancer.description: Independent work, with clients and quotes.

agency.label: Agency
agency.description: Marketing, design, development or communication for clients.

real_estate.label: Real estate
real_estate.description: Property sales and rentals, brokers and listings.

saas.label: Software / SaaS
saas.description: Digital product sold by subscription or license.

sales.label: B2B sales
sales.description: A sales team selling products or services to other organizations.

other.label: Other
other.description: None of the options above describes your business well.

product.label: Products
product.description: Physical or digital items sold per unit.

recurring.label: Recurring
recurring.description: Subscriptions, monthly fees or renewed contracts.

features.title: Choose your features
features.description: We turned on what usually helps a business like yours ({{business}}). Adjust as you like; you can change it anytime in Settings.
features.needsSetup: Features that need a few details
features.needsSetupHint: These connect to external services, so they ask for some information before being added.
features.configurationHint: Fill in the details of this feature and of what it needs. They are saved when the workspace is created.
features.invalidConfiguration: Some details are not valid. Check the highlighted fields.

account.title: Create your administrator account
account.description: This is the account you will sign in with. Check the summary and create your workspace.

email.title: Connect your email
email.description: Aphel sends invitations to your team, password resets and notifications by email. Connect your SMTP server so they reach people right away.
email.later: You can skip this: invitations and password resets will show a link for you to copy and send. Connect email anytime in Settings › Outgoing email.

ready.title: All set!
ready.description: Your workspace is ready to use.

next.import: Bring your people and organizations from a spreadsheet.
next.invite: Invite your team from Settings › Members.
next.customize: Adjust fields, pipelines and features whenever you need.

ready.created: Workspace {{name}} created with the features you chose.

restore.title: Restore from a backup
restore.description: Use the backup file (.zip) exported from another Aphel installation. It brings the company, users, records and files; afterwards, sign in with an account from the backup.
restore.hint: Restoring is only possible on this empty installation.

errors.tooLarge: The file is larger than allowed.
errors.generic: Could not restore the backup. Try again.

errors.passwordLength: The password must be between 8 and 128 characters.
errors.business: Check the answers about your business.
errors.features: Check the details of the selected features.
errors.statusFailed: Could not reach the server to prepare the setup.
errors.network: No connection to the server. Check your network and try again.
errors.generic: The workspace could not be created. Please try again.
